errors.what: Initial clan read failed (No such file or directory) using prompt-relative path because the agent cwd is the heavy subdir, not the repo root
errors.recovered_by: Running each clan command with a cd to the repo root, where the test-sandbox-relative paths resolve

problems_and_friction: Agent cwd resets to the heavy subdir between bash calls while prompt paths are repo-root-relative, so the first read failed until I prefixed commands with a cd to the repo root. The doc already carried my comp_* fields from a prior run, but patch-data is a merge so re-applying was idempotent.
context_understood: As the competitive-intel analyst I merge-patched five comp_* findings (HubSpot/Zoho/Salesforce strengths, low Zoho switching cost, Zoho export clause) into the shared Brightline CRM doc, preserving all prior analysts' data.
